title: Journal Event
description: One line of a groundwork journal shard (.jsonl). Appended atomically by hooks/journal.mjs via hooks/lib/journal-io.mjs.
$comment: Invariants NOT enforced by this schema (implemented as hand-written checks in STD6 / hooks/journal.mjs): (1) NEVER_COMPRESS enforcement — DECISION and SPEC_CHANGE events must not be folded into digest summaries; this is a runtime policy, not a structural constraint; (2) shard-path naming — events are stored under .groundwork/journal/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<session_id>.jsonl; the session_id in the path is not cross-checked against the 'session' field here; (3) rfc and msg are required by the journal CLI (hooks/journal.mjs line 148) but not by all journal writers — e.g. SESSION_START events emitted by session-hook writers may omit both.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was appended (UTC).

session.description: Claude Code session id (or named session handle) of the agent that appended the event.

rfc.description: RFC identifier the event belongs to (e.g. R-20260726-K4M2QX). Required by the journal CLI; may be absent on session-start hook events.

type.description: Event type drawn from VALID_TYPES in hooks/lib/journal-io.mjs (12 values as of 2026-07-26; STEERING_UPDATE was removed).

msg.description: Human-readable event message. Required by the journal CLI; may be absent on non-CLI writers.

data.description: Optional structured payload attached by the journal CLI (--data flag). Shape is type-specific and not constrained here.
